# HumanEval/101: `words_string`

Implement the function below in `solution.py`. The docstring is the specification.

```python

def words_string(s):
    """
    You will be given a string of words separated by commas or spaces. Your task is
    to split the string into words and return an array of the words.
    
    For example:
    words_string("Hi, my name is John") == ["Hi", "my", "name", "is", "John"]
    words_string("One, two, three, four, five, six") == ["One", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six"]
    """
```

## Input contract
Callers only pass inputs satisfying these checks; behavior on other inputs is unspecified (do not test outside them):
```python
assert isinstance(s, str), "invalid inputs"
```
